## Incident decomposition

- macOS job 94963923783: extension-host realpath test disagrees with the privacy-safe external-path projection introduced by the closed version-skew lineage.
- Ubuntu job 94963923789: tracker-context-quality blocks on missing-linked-path ceiling growth and one integrity finding; telemetry is warning-only.
- Windows job 94963923863: authoritative linked-test collection disappears from a stat-matched cache fixture, and the caller-owned scale benchmark exceeds its 30-second budget.
- Controls: Node 22 and Node 25 Ubuntu jobs pass in the same run.

## Guardrails

Do not relax privacy-safe path redaction, tracker assurance ceilings, authoritative cache semantics, or the uniform timeout budget merely to make the scheduled job green. Establish the current contract and population semantics first, then repair the implementation or fixture.
GH-1019/GH-1020/GH-1021: Node 24 nightly platform regressions after PR #1016

The scheduled Node-version matrix failed on macOS, Ubuntu, and Windows at merge commit 26feeed1480955eb20be46785c4ef4210a23916c while the Node 22 and Node 25 Ubuntu controls passed. The three GitHub alerts are one cross-platform regression incident with distinct platform symptoms and established historical predecessors.

Add focused tests that reproduce all four observed failure modes without weakening existing ratchets; fix root causes or update invalid fixtures only where the shipped contract changed intentionally; run the focused suites and the full nightly-equivalent matrix; close GitHub issues #1019, #1020, and #1021 with the PM link and exact green run evidence.
Restore deterministic cross-platform Node 24 nightly assurance without weakening privacy, tracker-quality, cache-correctness, or timeout ratchets.
Scheduled compatibility evidence catches platform-specific regressions that exact-main Linux gates cannot prove.
Until resolved, the daily compatibility signal is red on all three platform jobs and can mask future regressions.
One subsequent scheduled Node-version matrix run is green on macOS, Ubuntu, and Windows at Node 24, with focused regression tests preserving each invariant.
GitHub opened three live failure alerts from the same scheduled run; they need one canonical PM lineage before implementation so alert state and predecessor history remain traversable.
GitHub Actions run 31864756573; merge commit 26feeed1480955eb20be46785c4ef4210a23916c; Node 24 scheduled matrix on macos-latest, ubuntu-latest, windows-latest
Open nightly run 31864756573. Inspect jobs 94963923783 (macOS), 94963923789 (Ubuntu), and 94963923863 (Windows). Compare with passing Node 22 and Node 25 Ubuntu jobs in the same run.

Every supported Node-version/platform matrix job passes from a clean checkout; privacy-safe path normalization, stat-matched collection caching, scale-benchmark ownership, and tracker quality gates remain deterministic.

macOS expected a shared-pm/package.json suffix but received the privacy-safe <external>/<hash>/shared-pm/package.json projection; Ubuntu blocked on linked-path ceiling 204>195 and health-integrity 1>0; Windows lost an authoritative linked-test collection from the stat-matched cache and timed out the caller-owned scale-benchmark workspace test at 30 seconds.
